method: 3-state Gaussian HMM (hand-rolled Baum-Welch) on walk-forward weather-adjusted daily load; monthly expanding refit, forward-filtered states; states ordered by mean (green < grey < red)
notes: Colors compare consumption with what the weather explains (temperature + weekend), not raw use.
Timeline and current state are forward-filtered: each day uses only data up to that day.
Data end 2023-12-31 (ISO-NE files for 2024+ were not available); 'current' is that day.
Load is all customer classes (homes + businesses) in each ISO-NE zone.
